title: Uncurried maps from a finite presentation lift into a stage tensor module
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed partially ordered set, $F:I\to\mathrm{CRing}$ a functor, $A=\operatorname{colim}_I F$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], $i\in I$, and $M,N$ be $F_i$-modules in a common universe containing the ring universe. Assume $M$ is finitely presented [def-sc-finitely-presented-module]. Given an $F_i$-linear map $h:M\to\operatorname{Res}_{F_i}^{A}(A\otimes_{F_i}N)$, there exist $j\ge i$ and an $F_i$-linear map $a:M\to\operatorname{Res}_{F_i}^{F_j}(F_j\otimes_{F_i}N)$. For every $A$-linear isomorphism $e:A\otimes_{F_i}N\to A\otimes_{F_j}(F_j\otimes_{F_i}N)$ which sends $1\otimes n$ to $1\otimes(1\otimes n)$, one has $e(h(x))=1\otimes a(x)$ for every $x\in M$. There is no finite-presentation assumption on $N$.

proof.text: Take finite generators of M and finite generators of the relation kernel, using finite presentation. Write their images under h as finite sums of pure tensors. Lift the finitely many ring coefficients to one stage j above i, giving tentative generator images in Fj tensor N.

The finitely many relation combinations of the tentative images become zero over A. Apply eventual finite tensor vanishing to these elements of Fj tensor N, using the canonical comparison of successive tensor products. Enlarge j once so that all relations vanish. The tentative images then induce an Fi-linear map a from M.

A comparison e with the stated unit-tensor formula agrees on arbitrary pure tensors by A-linearity, and hence on finite sums. Check e(h(x))=1 tensor a(x) on the chosen generators, then on their Fi-span, which is M.

theorem exists_stage_restricted_hom
    {I : Type u} [PartialOrder I] [Nonempty I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (F : I ⥤ CommRingCat) (i : I) (M N : ModuleCat.{max u v} (F.obj i))
    [Module.FinitePresentation (F.obj i) M]
    (h : M ⟶ (restrictScalars (CommRingCat.Hom.hom (colimit.ι F i))).obj
      ((extendScalars (CommRingCat.Hom.hom (colimit.ι F i))).obj N)) :
    ∃ (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j),
      let rij := CommRingCat.Hom.hom (F.map (homOfLE hij))
      let rj := CommRingCat.Hom.hom (colimit.ι F j)
      let ri := CommRingCat.Hom.hom (colimit.ι F i)
      ∃ (a : M ⟶ (restrictScalars rij).obj ((extendScalars rij).obj N)),
        ∀ (e : (extendScalars ri).obj N ≅
          (extendScalars rj).obj ((extendScalars rij).obj N)),
          (∀ n : N, e.hom ((1 : ↑(colimit F : CommRingCat)) ⊗ₜ[F.obj i, ri] n) =
            (1 : ↑(colimit F : CommRingCat)) ⊗ₜ[F.obj j, rj]
              ((1 : ↑(F.obj j)) ⊗ₜ[F.obj i, rij] n)) →
          ∀ m : M, e.hom (h m) =
            (1 : ↑(colimit F : CommRingCat)) ⊗ₜ[F.obj j, rj] (a m)
